pob.text: Behold[a], the Lord will dispossess her and strike her wealth into the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, the Lord will impoverish her and cast her wealth into the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
public_domain_references.brenton: And therefore the Lord will take them for a possession, and will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be consumed with fire.

spob.text: Ashkelon will see what has happened and be afraid. Gaza will writhe in great anguish, and Ekron too will be in anguish because her hope has ended in shame.[a] A king will perish from Gaza,[b] and no one will live in Ashkelon.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, as will Ekron, for her hope will wither. There will cease to be a king in Gaza, and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.
public_domain_references.web: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
public_domain_references.asv: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also, and shall be sore pained; and Ekron, for her expectation shall be put to shame; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
public_domain_references.kjv: Ashkelon shall see [it], and fear; Gaza also [shall see it], and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
public_domain_references.brenton: Ascalon shall see, and fear; Gaza also, and shall be greatly pained, and Accaron; for she is ashamed at her trespass; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ascalon shall not be inhabited.

pob.text: A mixed people will dwell in Ashdod[a], and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

spob.text: A mixed population will live in Ashdod,[a] and I will cut off the Philistines’ pride.

public_domain_references.bsb: A mixed race will occupy Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
public_domain_references.web: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
public_domain_references.asv: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
public_domain_references.kjv: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
public_domain_references.brenton: And aliens shall dwell in Azotus, and I will bring down the pride of the Philistines.

pob.text: I will remove his blood from his mouth and his detestable things from between his teeth[a]. Then he too will be a remnant for our God; he will be like a clan leader in Judah[c][b], and Ekron will be like the Jebusite.

spob.text: I will remove the blood from his mouth and the detestable things from between his teeth.[a] Then he too will remain for our God.[b] He will be like one of Judah’s clan leaders, and Ekron will be like the Jebusite.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: I will remove the blood from their mouths and the abominations from between their teeth. Then they too will become a remnant for our God; they will become like a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
public_domain_references.web: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also shall be a remnant for our God; and he shall be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, [shall be] for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will take their blood out of their mouth, and their abominations from between their teeth; and these also shall be left to our God, and they shall be as a captain of a thousand in Juda, and Accaron as a Jebusite.

pob.text: And I will encamp at my house as a guard[a], so that none may pass to and fro, and no oppressor will pass over them again[c][b]; for now I have seen with my own eyes.

spob.text: I will set up camp at my house[a] and stand guard. I will keep hostile forces from moving back and forth, and no oppressor will overrun them again. For now I have seen with my own eyes.

public_domain_references.bsb: But I will camp around My house because of an army, because of those who march to and fro, and never again will an oppressor overrun My people, for now I keep watch with My own eyes.
public_domain_references.web: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will encamp about my house against the army, that none pass through or return; and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will set up a defence for my house, that they may not pass through, nor turn back, neither shall there any more come upon them one to drive them away: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

pob.text: Rejoice greatly[a], daughter Zion! Shout in triumph, daughter Jerusalem! Look, your king is coming to you—righteous and victorious is he, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt[c][b], the foal of a she-donkey.

spob.text: Celebrate with great joy, daughter Zion! Shout in triumph, daughter Jerusalem! Look! Your king is coming to you. He is righteous and victorious.[a] He is humble[b] and rides on a donkey—a colt, the foal of a female donkey.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
public_domain_references.web: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
public_domain_references.asv: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy king cometh unto thee; he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, even upon a colt the foal of an ass.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he [is] just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
public_domain_references.brenton: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Sion; proclaim [it] aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem; behold, the King is coming to thee, just, and a Saviour; he is meek and riding on an ass, and a young foal.

pob.text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem[a], and the battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations, and his dominion will be from sea to sea[b], and from the River to the ends of the earth.

spob.text: “I will remove the war chariots from Ephraim and the war horses from Jerusalem. The battle bows will also be removed. The king will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River[a] to the ends of the earth.”

public_domain_references.bsb: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
public_domain_references.web: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off; and he shall speak peace unto the nations: and his dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion [shall be] from sea [even] to sea, and from the river [even] to the ends of the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he shall destroy the chariots out of Ephraim, and the horse out of Jerusalem, and the bow of war shall be utterly destroyed; and [there shall be] abundance and peace out of the nations; and he shall rule over the waters as far as the sea, and the rivers [to] the ends of the earth.

pob.text: As for you also[a], because of the blood of your covenant[b], I have sent out your prisoners from the pit in which there is no water.

spob.text: And as for you too, because of the blood of your covenant,[a] I have released your prisoners from the waterless pit.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.
public_domain_references.web: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
public_domain_references.asv: As for thee also, because of the blood of thy covenant I have set free thy prisoners from the pit wherein is no water.
public_domain_references.kjv: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein [is] no water.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou by the blood of thy covenant hast sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit that has no water.

pob.text: Return to the stronghold[a], prisoners of hope[b]; even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

spob.text: Come back to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope.[a] Even today I announce: I will restore twice as much to you.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; even today I declare that I will restore to you double.
public_domain_references.web: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
public_domain_references.asv: Turn you to the stronghold, ye prisoners of hope: even to-day do I declare that I will render double unto thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare [that] I will render double unto thee;
public_domain_references.brenton: Ye shall dwell in strongholds, ye prisoners of the congregation: and for one day of thy captivity I will recompense thee double.

pob.text: For I have bent Judah as my bow; I have filled it with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons[a], Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like a warrior’s sword.

spob.text: For I have bent Judah, making it my bow, and I have filled the bow with Ephraim. Zion, I will rouse your sons against the sons of Greece,[a] and I will make you like a warrior’s sword.

public_domain_references.bsb: For I will bend Judah as My bow and fit it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, O Zion, against the sons of Greece. I will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
public_domain_references.web: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
public_domain_references.asv: For I have bent Judah for me, I have filled the bow with Ephraim; and I will stir up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and will make thee as the sword of a mighty man.
public_domain_references.kjv: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
public_domain_references.brenton: For I have bent thee, O Juda, for myself [as] a bow, I have filled Ephraim; and I will raise up thy children, O Sion, against the children of the Greeks, and I will handle thee as the sword of a warrior.

pob.text: Then Yahweh will appear over them[a], and his arrow will go out like lightning[b]; and the Lord GOD will sound the trumpet and march in the whirlwinds of the south.

spob.text: Then Yahweh will appear over them. His arrow will fly out like a flash of lightning. The Lord GOD will sound the trumpet[a] and advance in storm winds of the south.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the LORD will appear over them, and His arrow will go forth like lightning. The Lord GOD will sound the ram’s horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
public_domain_references.asv: And Jehovah shall be seen over them; and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning; and the Lord Jehovah will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord shall be over them, and [his] arrow shall go forth as lightning: and the Lord Almighty shall blow with the trumpet; and shall proceed with the tumult of his threatening.

pob.text: The LORD of Armies will shield them, and they will devour and trample the sling stones; they will drink and roar as if with wine, and they will be filled like a bowl, like the corners of the altar.

spob.text: The LORD of Armies will protect them. They will devour and trample the stones hurled from slings. They will drink and roar as if with wine. They will be filled like a bowl, like the corners of the altar.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD of Hosts will shield them. They will destroy and conquer with slingstones; they will drink and roar as with wine. And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls, drenched like the corners of the altar.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah of hosts will defend them; and they shall devour, and shall tread down the sling-stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, [and] make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, [and] as the corners of the altar.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord Almighty shall protect them, and they shall destroy them, and overwhelm them with sling-stones; and they shall swallow them down as wine, and fill the bowls as the altar.

pob.text: And Yahweh their God will save them on that day as the flock of his people[b][a], for they will sparkle like the stones of a crown over his land.

spob.text: On that day, Yahweh their God will save them as his own flock, his people. For they will sparkle over his land like jewels set in a crown.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people; for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
public_domain_references.asv: And Jehovah their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for [they shall be as] the stones of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they [shall be as] the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day, [even] his people as a flock; for holy stones are rolled upon his land.

pob.text: For how great is his goodness[a], and how great his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish[c][b], and new wine the young women.

spob.text: His goodness is so great, and so is his beauty![a] Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine will make the young women flourish.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: How lovely they will be, and how beautiful! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the young women.
public_domain_references.web: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
public_domain_references.asv: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
public_domain_references.kjv: For how great [is] his goodness, and how great [is] his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
public_domain_references.brenton: For if he has anything good, and if he has anything fair, the young [men shall have] corn, and [there shall be] fragrant wine to the virgins.

pob.text: Ask Yahweh for rain in the time of the latter rain[a]; Yahweh makes storm clouds, and he will give them showers of rain[b], to each man vegetation in the field.

spob.text: Ask Yahweh for rain in the season of the late rain.[a] Yahweh makes storm clouds.[b] He will give them rain showers and give each man[c] plants in the field.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
public_domain_references.web: Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
public_domain_references.asv: Ask ye of Jehovah rain in the time of the latter rain, [even of] Jehovah that maketh lightnings; and he will give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
public_domain_references.kjv: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; [so] the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
public_domain_references.brenton: Ask ye of the Lord rain in season, the early and the latter: the Lord has given bright signs, and will give them abundant rain, to every one grass in the field.

pob.text: For the household idols speak wickedness[a], and the diviners see lies; they speak empty dreams and give vain comfort. Therefore they wander like sheep[b]; they are afflicted because there is no shepherd.

spob.text: The household idols[a] speak evil. Diviners see false visions; they tell empty dreams and offer comfort that is no help. So the people wander like sheep. They suffer because they have no shepherd.

public_domain_references.bsb: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
public_domain_references.web: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.
public_domain_references.asv: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams, they comfort in vain: therefore they go their way like sheep, they are afflicted, because there is no shepherd.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because [there was] no shepherd.
public_domain_references.brenton: For the speakers have uttered grievous things, and the diviners [have ] [seen] false visions, and they have spoken false dreams, they have given vain comfort: therefore have they fallen away like sheep, and been afflicted, because there was no healing.

pob.text: My anger burns against the shepherds[a], and I will punish the male goats; for Yahweh of Armies has attended to his flock, the house of Judah[b], and will make them like his majestic horse in battle.

spob.text: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats.[a] For Yahweh of Armies has cared for his flock, the people of Judah, and he will make them like his majestic horse in battle.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
public_domain_references.web: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for Yahweh of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.
public_domain_references.asv: Mine anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the he-goats; for Jehovah of hosts hath visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his goodly horse in the battle.
public_domain_references.kjv: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
public_domain_references.brenton: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I will visit the lambs; and the Lord God Almighty shall visit his flock, the house of Juda, and he shall make them as his goodly horse in war.

pob.text: From him will come the cornerstone[a], from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow[b]; from him every ruler will go out together.

spob.text: The cornerstone, the tent peg, and the battle bow[a] will each come from him. All rulers[b] will go out from him together.

public_domain_references.bsb: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
public_domain_references.web: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
public_domain_references.asv: From him shall come forth the corner-stone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
public_domain_references.kjv: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
public_domain_references.brenton: And from him he looked, and from him he set [the battle in order], and from him [came] the bow in anger, [and] from him shall come forth every oppressor together.

pob.text: They will be like mighty men[a], trampling the mire of the streets in battle; they will fight, because Yahweh is with them, and they will put horsemen to shame.

spob.text: They will be like mighty men[a] in battle, trampling the mud in the streets. They will fight because Yahweh is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.

public_domain_references.bsb: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
public_domain_references.web: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because Yahweh is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.
public_domain_references.asv: And they shall be as mighty men, treading down [their enemies] in the mire of the streets in the battle; and they shall fight, because Jehovah is with them; and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And they shall be as mighty [men], which tread down [their enemies] in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD [is] with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall be as warriors treading clay in the ways in war; and they shall set the battle in array, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be put to shame.

pob.text: I will strengthen the house of Judah[a], and I will save the house of Joseph. I will restore them, because I have had compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them; for I am Yahweh their God[b], and I will answer them.

spob.text: I will make the house of Judah[a] strong, and I will save the house of Joseph.[b] Because I have shown them compassion, I will restore them.[c] They will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am Yahweh their God, and I will answer them.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
public_domain_references.web: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am Yahweh their God, and I will hear them.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them back; for I have mercy upon them; and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Jehovah their God, and I will hear them.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I [am] the LORD their God, and will hear them.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will strengthen the house of Juda, and save the house of Joseph, and I will settle them; because I have loved them: and they shall be as [if] I had not cast them off: for I am the Lord their God, and I will hear them.

pob.text: Ephraim will be like a mighty warrior[a], and their heart will rejoice as with wine; their children will see and rejoice[b]; their heart will exult in Yahweh.

spob.text: The people of Ephraim will be like mighty warriors. Their hearts will be glad, as when wine brings joy. Their children[a] will see this and rejoice. Their hearts will overflow with joy in Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: And [they of] Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine; yea, their children shall see it, and rejoice; their heart shall be glad in Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And [they of] Ephraim shall be like a mighty [man], and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see [it], and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall be as the warriors of Ephraim, and their heart shall rejoice as with wine: and their children also shall see [it], and be glad; and their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.

pob.text: I will whistle for them and gather them[a], for I have redeemed them[b], and they will be as many as they were before.

spob.text: I will whistle to summon them, and I will gather them, because I have redeemed them. They will again be as numerous as they were before.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
public_domain_references.web: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.
